python - <<'PY'
import numpy as np,json
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import fclusterdata
from PIL import Image
m=json.load(open('/app/output/initial/meta.json'))
for c in m['cameras']:
 d=np.load('/app/output/initial/depth_'+c+'.npy').astype(float); rgb=np.array(Image.open('/app/output/initial_'+c+'.png')); C=np.array(m['cameras'][c]['cam2world_gl']); K=np.array(m['cameras'][c]['intrinsic_cv']); v,u=np.indices(d.shape)
 xyz=np.stack([(u-K[0,2])*d/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*d/K[1,1],-d],axis=-1)@C[:3,:3].T+C[:3,3]
 mask=(xyz[:,:,2]>.005)&(xyz[:,:,2]<.10)&(abs(xyz[:,:,0])<.35)&(xyz[:,:,1]>.5)&(xyz[:,:,1]<1.05)
 pts=xyz[mask]; colors=rgb[mask]
 red=(colors[:,0]>colors[:,1]*1.7)&(colors[:,0]>colors[:,2]*1.7)&(colors[:,0]>50)
 print(c,'elevated',len(pts),'red',len(pts[red]))
 if red.any(): print('red range',pts[red].min(0),pts[red].max(0),'median',np.median(pts[red],axis=0))
 if len(pts):
  labels=fclusterdata(pts,t=.022,criterion='distance',method='single')
  for l in np.unique(labels):
   p=pts[labels==l]
   if len(p)>5: print('cluster',len(p),'bounds',p.min(0),p.max(0),'median',np.median(p,axis=0))
 np.savez('/app/output/initial/cloud_'+c+'.npz',xyz=xyz,rgb=rgb)
